```{r}
c3 <- read.table("E:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_circexp3.txt",sep="\t",header = T)

c3$chr <- sub(":.*", "",c3$x)
c3$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",c3$x)
c3$Start <- as.numeric(c3$Start)+1
c3$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",c3$x) 
c3$pip <- "c3"

cq <- read.table("E:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_ciri.txt",sep="\t",header = T)
cq$chr <- sub(":.*", "",cq$x)
cq$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",cq$x)
cq$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",cq$x) 
cq$pip <- "cq"
cq$Start <- as.numeric(cq$Start)

c3_cq<- merge(c3,cq,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"))
c3_cq <- length(c3_cq$chr) #46.302
c3_cq$circRNA_ID <- paste0(c3_cq$chr,":",c3_cq$Start,"|",c3_cq$End)
c3_cq <- c3_cq[!is.na(c3_cq$pip.x)==FALSE|!is.na(c3_cq$pip.y)==FALSE,] 
c3_cq$software <- "circexp3_and_ciriquant"

left_c3<-merge(c3,cq,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"),all.x=TRUE)
left_c3$circRNA_ID <- paste0(left_c3$chr,":",left_c3$Start,"|",left_c3$End)
num_only_c3<-sum(!is.na(left_c3$pip.y)==FALSE) #3.419
left_c3 <- left_c3[!is.na(left_c3$pip.y)==FALSE,] 
left_c3$software <- "circexp3"


right_cq<-merge(c3,cq,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"),all.y=TRUE)
right_cq$circRNA_ID <- paste0(right_cq$chr,":",right_cq$Start,"|",right_cq$End)
num_only_cq<-sum(!is.na(right_cq$pip.x)==FALSE) #23.739
right_cq <- right_cq[!is.na(right_cq$pip.x)==FALSE,] 
right_cq$software <- "ciriquant"

all_circ<- rbind(c3_cq,left_c3,right_cq)
all_circ<-all_circ[,c(8,9)]

write.table(all_circ,paste0("E:/45_circRNAs_seba/all_circrnas.txt"), sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

```

```{r}

c3_6 <- read.table("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann.txt",sep="\t",header=T) 
c3_6$chr <- sub(":.*", "",c3_6$rn)
c3_6$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",c3_6$rn)
c3_6$Start <- as.numeric(c3_6$Start)+1
c3_6$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",c3_6$rn) 
c3_6$pip <- "c3"

cq_6 <- read.table("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann.txt",sep="\t",header=T) 

cq_6$chr <- sub(":.*", "",cq_6$rn)
cq_6$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",cq_6$rn)
cq_6$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",cq_6$rn) 
cq_6$pip <- "cq"
cq_6$Start <- as.numeric(cq_6$Start)

library(dplyr)
c3_cq_6<- merge(c3_6,cq_6,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"))
c3_cq_6 <- c3_cq_6 %>% arrange(desc(c3_cq_6$log2FoldChange.x))
length(c3_cq_6)
c3_cq_6$circRNA_ID <- paste0(c3_cq_6$chr,":",c3_cq_6$Start,"|",c3_cq_6$End)
c3_cq_6$software <- "circexp3_and_ciriquant"

left_c3_6<-merge(c3_6,cq_6,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"),all.x=TRUE)
left_c3_6$circRNA_ID <- paste0(left_c3_6$chr,":",left_c3_6$Start,"|",left_c3_6$End)
left_c3_6 <- left_c3_6[!is.na(left_c3_6$pip.y)==FALSE,] 
left_c3_6$software <- "circexp3"

right_cq_6<-merge(c3_6,cq_6,by.x=c("chr","Start","End"), by.y=c("chr","Start","End"),all.y=TRUE)
right_cq_6$circRNA_ID <- paste0(right_cq_6$chr,":",right_cq_6$Start,"|",right_cq_6$End)
num_only_cq_6<-sum(!is.na(right_cq_6$pip.x)==FALSE) #23.739
right_cq_6 <- right_cq_6[!is.na(right_cq_6$pip.x)==FALSE,] 
right_cq_6$software <- "ciriquant"

all_circ_de6<- rbind(c3_cq_6,left_c3_6,right_cq_6)

all_circ_de6 <- all_circ_de6 %>%
                             mutate(regulations = ifelse(!is.na(Regulation.x), Regulation.x,Regulation.y)) %>%
                             mutate(geneName = ifelse(!is.na(geneName.x), geneName.x,geneName.y)) %>%
                             mutate(circRNA_ID2 = paste0(circRNA_ID," | ",geneName)) %>%
                             mutate(log2FC = ifelse(!is.na(log2FoldChange.x), log2FoldChange.x,log2FoldChange.y)) %>%
                             mutate(pvalue = ifelse(!is.na(pvalue.x), pvalue.x,pvalue.y)) 
                            
all_circ_de6<-all_circ_de6[,c(24,28,29,30,26,25)]
all_circ_de6<-all_circ_de6 %>% arrange(desc(log2FC))


write.table(all_circ_de6,paste0("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/all_de6_circrnas.txt"), sep="\t",quote = F,row.names = F,col.names = T)

```

```{r}

all_circ_de24_2 <- all_circ_de24 %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n=10)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
Grafico2 <-ggplot(all_circ_de24, aes(x= log2FC, 
                            y= -log10(pvalue), 
                            colour=regulations)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, size=1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = all_circ_de24_2, 
                   aes(label = all_circ_de24_2$circRNA_ID2), 
                   max.overlaps = Inf, 
                   size=3,
                   force = 100, 
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   color="black",
                   #xlim=c(-5,5), 
                   #ylim=c(4,7.5),
                   force_pull = 5)+#+
  xlab(paste("log2 FoldChange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("-log10 pvalue ") +
  xlim(c(-5, 5)) + 
  ylim(c(0,7.5 )) +
  ggtitle("")+

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up"= "red","Down"="blue","Unchanged"="darkgray"))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  labs(fill = "Regulation")+
  theme_classic()

print(Grafico2)
library(Cairo)

cairo_pdf(paste0("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/Volcano_c24_n24_labeled_new.pdf"),width = 7,height = 6)
print(Grafico2)
dev.off()
```

c3_24 <- read.table("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/normalized_deseq2_count_matrix_cexp3_24.txt",sep="\t",header=T) 
c3_24$chr <- sub(":.*", "",c3_24$rn)
c3_24$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",c3_24$rn)
c3_24$Start <- as.numeric(c3_24$Start)+1
c3_24$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",c3_24$rn) 
c3_24$pip <- "c3"
c3_24$circRNA_ID <- paste0(c3_24$chr,":",c3_24$Start,"|",c3_24$End)

cq_24 <- read.table("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/normalized_deseq2_count_matrix_ciri_24.txt",sep="\t",header=T) 

cq_24$chr <- sub(":.*", "",cq_24$rn)
cq_24$Start <-  sub(".*:(\\d+)\\|.*", "\\1",cq_24$rn)
cq_24$End = sub(".*\\|(\\d+)", "\\1",cq_24$rn) 
cq_24$pip <- "cq"
cq_24$Start <- as.numeric(cq_24$Start)
cq_24$circRNA_ID <- paste0(cq_24$chr,":",cq_24$Start,"|",cq_24$End)

c3_cq_24<- merge(cq_24,c3_24,by.x="circRNA_ID", by.y="circRNA_ID",all=T)

c3_cq_24 <- c3_cq_24 %>%     mutate(c24_1 = ifelse(!is.na(c24_1.x), c24_1.x,c24_1.y)) %>%
  mutate(c24_1 = ifelse(!is.na(c24_1.x), c24_1.x,c24_1.y)) %>%
  mutate(c24_2 = ifelse(!is.na(c24_2.x), c24_2.x,c24_2.y)) %>%
  mutate(c24_3 = ifelse(!is.na(c24_3.x), c24_3.x,c24_3.y)) %>%
  mutate(c24_4 = ifelse(!is.na(c24_4.x), c24_4.x,c24_4.y)) %>%
  mutate(n24_1 = ifelse(!is.na(n24_1.x), n24_1.x,c24_1.y)) %>%
  mutate(n24_2 = ifelse(!is.na(n24_2.x), n24_2.x,c24_2.y)) %>%
  mutate(n24_3 = ifelse(!is.na(n24_3.x), n24_3.x,c24_3.y)) %>%
  mutate(n24_4 = ifelse(!is.na(n24_4.x), n24_4.x,c24_4.y)) %>%
  mutate(pip = ifelse(!is.na(pip.x), pip.x,pip.y)) 

c3_cq_24 <- c3_cq_24[,c(1,28:35)]

write.table(c3_cq_24,paste0("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/norm_deseq2_count_matrix_all_24.txt"), sep="\t",row.names = F,col.names = T,quote = F)



c3_cq_24<- merge(cq_24,c3_24,by.x="circRNA_ID", by.y="circRNA_ID",all=T)
c3_cq_24<-c3_cq_24[,c("circRNA_ID","rn.x","rn.y")]
c3_cq_24_2 <- c3_cq_24 %>%
  mutate(pip = case_when(
    !is.na(rn.x) & !is.na(rn.y) ~ "ciriquant_and_circexp3",
    !is.na(rn.x) ~ "ciriquant",
    !is.na(rn.y) ~ "circexp3",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
